item.title: Electro-Harmonix Reveals the Adrian Belew Echoflanger
item.dc:creator: Electro Harmonix
item.content:encoded:
$239.00

Find a Dealer

MORE DETAILS

Analog EHX Classic with Vintage Vibes and Signature Tones!

From his career launching stints with Frank Zappa and David Bowie, collaboration with the likes of the Talking Heads and the Tom Tom Club, and his career defining years in King Crimson, Adrian Belew has always been on the cutting edge of using effects for cultivating intriguing and out-of-this-world guitar tones. Ever at his left-hand, the Electro-Harmonix Echoflanger had been employed to create some of Adrian’s most notable sounds. Now, Electro-Harmonix and Adrian have teamed up to present a limited signature version of the fabled modulator.

The Adrian Belew Echoflanger is an all-analog multi-mode modulation pedal capable of producing sounds from smooth and airy to warped and wild. Classic modes from the original include Filter Matrix, Flange, Chorus, and Slap Back, plus new combination modes: Slap Back + Filter Matrix and Adrian’s signature Chorus + Flange. In addition to standard modulation controls like VOLUME, RATE and WIDTH for setting output, speed, and range of effect, the Echoflanger includes a TUNE knob for dialing in the centerpoint of the modulation waveform, and a FEEDBACK knob to adjust from mild mods to runaway self-oscillation. The BLEND switch adds/removes the dry signal from the effect signal for traditional chorus/flanger-type effects or more intense vibrato sounds.

The new twist on a classic tone twister features stereo outputs and true bypass with mechanical relays. The pedal ships with standard EHX 9 Volt power supply, is available now and has a U.S. Street Price of $239.00.

Learn more at www.ehx.com/echoflanger

item.title: Electro-Harmonix Presents the Deluxe Big Muff 2
item.dc:creator: Electro Harmonix
item.content:encoded:
$188.20

Find a Dealer

MORE DETAILS

Top-tier features added to the long-lost Dual Op-Amp Big Muff 2

Giving into their maximalist compulsions, Electro-Harmonix introduces the Deluxe Big Muff Pi 2, their latest take and final chapter in the long-lost dual-op amp Big Muff 2 story. Building off of the long-lost fuzz’s unique tone, this Deluxe version brings the concept to its peak with versatile tone shaping power.

The Deluxe Big Muff 2 takes the Big Muff 2’s mids-driven tone and classic singing sustain and adds EHX’s favorite upgrades. The tried and true VOL/TONE/SUSTAIN knobs control the overall output, EQ, and gain level of the pedal respectively. New editions include a 3-way WICKER switch, footswitchable MIDs section, and adjustable noise GATE. The WICKER switch opens up high-frequency filters for extra sizzle and clarity especially when dialing in darker, wooly tones. The parametric MIDS section includes a MIDS FREQ and LEVEL knobs to boost or cut mid frequencies with a switchable Hi/Lo Q resonance adjustment. Adding an expression pedal or CV controller via the EXP input enables real-time control over the MIDS FREQ for freaky fuzz wah effects.

The Deluxe Big Muff Pi 2 features a bypass footswitch with Latching/Momentary Action. Click the footswitch for normal latching functionality or press and hold the footswitch for a momentary burst of fuzz.

This ultimate fuzz machine ships with a standard EHX 9 Volt power supply, is available now and has a U.S. Street Price of $188.20.

Learn more about the new EHX Deluxe Big Muff 2 at www.ehx.com/deluxebigmuff2

item.title: Electro-Harmonix Serves Up the EHX Percolator
item.dc:creator: Electro Harmonix
item.content:encoded:
$99.00

Find a Dealer

MORE DETAILS

Harmonic Saturator Tribute to an OG Overdrive!

Electro-Harmonix has released the EHX Percolator, a modern take on the incredibly rare Interfax Harmonic Percolator, an old-school fuzz drive famously utilized by Steve Albini on stage and in the studio. EHX have taken this unique circuit and added an ever useful bias control as well as a secondary clipping mode that lifts diodes for enhanced versatility.

Based on even-order harmonic clipping and capable of tones ranging from raunchy overdrive to a riot of heavy fuzz, the tone of the EHX Percolator can be both rich and brash with plenty of boost on tap. Adjust the HARMONICS control to set the input gain of the circuit and the BALANCE control to set the overall output level. The Bias control adjusts the bias of the gain circuit to achieve ripping gated sounds and enhanced sub-octave content. The FUZZ/DRIVE switch toggles between standard clipping operation (FUZZ) and lifted diode mode (DRIVE). In FUZZ mode, the EHX Percolator produces heavier fuzz tones while DRIVE mode makes the pedal act like a transistor drive with a raw, organic character. These controls are all interactive and the circuit reacts dynamically providing its wide range of tonal possibilities.

The EHX Percolator features True Bypass and a footswitch with Latching/Momentary action. Clicking the footswitch produces a normal latching function. A press and hold of the footswitch results in a momentary change between bypass states for a burst of fuzz and an instant change back to bypass when you lift your foot, or vice versa.

This ode to a true overdrive original ships with a 9 Volt battery, is available now and has a U.S. Street Price of $99.00.

Learn more about the new EHX Percolator Harmonic Saturator at www.ehx.com/perculator
